digest: S3 위반은 구현 코드와 명세의 직접 비교로 확인된다.

evidence.quote: 기본값은 50ms이고, 호출자가 더 작은 값을 주어도 10ms보다
evidence.relevance: S3 requires a 50ms default and a 10ms minimum.
Implementation uses a 200ms default and a 1ms minimum.

finalClaim: S3 is violated: createWorkflowStopSignal uses a 200ms default and clamps pollMs to 1ms, instead of the required 50ms default and 10ms minimum.
recommendedAction: Change the calculation to use a 50ms default and Math.max(10, ...), then add tests for the default and lower-bound behavior.
